comment: Douglass is awesome. Comes to class in a powdered wig, brings a bat, has students act out gang cases, including one student playing the part of a door. He is far from easy, and the closed book final sucks, but I formed my schedule around having him for Evidence and Crim Pro after having him for Crim Law.
Awesome in every way. Cares about students, cares about them learning, great guy, presents material clearly.
Great prof! Very nice and cute too! Don't be fooled by how easy the exam appears to be though. He's a tough grader.

Very tough final exam, very tough grader. He knows his stuff, but sometimes can't express it well enough. Plus, he acts like he's a kindergarten teacher, which can be good or bad depending on your personality.
Not only is he the hottest professor at U of R law but he is also one of the best. Incredible teacher who really cares about his students. And don't forget, he is sooo easy on the eyes.
